title: White Chicken Chili
equip: Instant Pot, Philips hand blender (stick + beaker, chopper attachment)

items.n: green chillies, de-seeded and finely chopped
chicken stock (1 Knorr chicken cube dissolved in hot water)
cans cannellini beans (800g total), drained and rinsed

steps.x: In the hand blender beaker, blend 1 can of the beans with 250ml of the stock until completely smooth, about 1 min. This is what makes it creamy without cream.
Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (High). Heat the oil, add onion, capsicum and green chillies, and cook 4 min until soft. Add garlic and all spices and stir 1 min.
Turn off Sauté. Add the remaining 250ml stock and scrape the bottom completely.
Lay the whole chicken thighs in a single layer. Add the remaining whole beans. Pour the bean purée over the top last and don't stir, because thick purée on the bottom can trigger a burn warning.
Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 min. Let it release naturally for 10 min, then release the rest.

parts.x: Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 min.
Let it release naturally for 10 min, then release the rest.

steps.x: Lift the chicken onto a board and shred with two forks. Return it to the pot and stir everything together. If it's thinner than you like, Sauté 3 min uncovered, stirring, to thicken. Stir in the lime juice and coriander.

notes: Approx. per portion: 395 kcal, 37g protein including yogurt. Add 1 tortilla or 100g cooked rice if you want more carbs.
Mild enough for kids. For adults, add chilli flakes or hot sauce at serving.
Fridge: 4 days. It thickens as it sits, so add a splash of water when reheating.
Freezer: 3 months. Reheat from frozen 4 min, stirring halfway.
Swap the cannellini for chickpeas if that's what's in the pantry; blend one can the same way.
